recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-22679 unless a future work-group decision changes the broader search escaping model.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I issue asking to remove the confusing claim that uri search matching was escape-sensitive and to correct a ValueSet URL percent-encoding example.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by source commit 82418ca8e77ceefa65a24270427f91e0a7d64f6e, which edited source/search.html for PR 1799 and changed the uri wording to case and accent sensitive while correcting the percent-encoded ValueSet example.
additional_context: FHIR-I 2019-10-28 minutes confirm the rationale that common HTTP processors unescape URLs, making escape-sensitive matching impractical or impossible. Later search-page work reorganized the escaping examples, and the related FHIR-42834 escaped-comma correction is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current source/search.html already states that URL percent encoding is a separate transparent layer and the uri section no longer mentions escape sensitivity.

related_jiras.note: Clarified escaped-comma examples in the same search escaping section after FHIR-22679 and is already represented on the combined branch.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asking to remove escape-sensitive uri search wording and correct a ValueSet URL percent-encoding example.

evidence_items.summary: The current escaping section separates FHIR backslash escaping from RFC 3986 percent encoding and shows percent-encoding variants with the same meaning.
evidence_items.learned: The current source preserves the FHIR-22679 rule that URL percent encoding is transparent for search processing.

evidence_items.summary: The uri search parameter type now says matches are precise, case and accent sensitive, and the entire URI must match.
evidence_items.learned: The current source has removed the escape-sensitive matching wording targeted by FHIR-22679.

evidence_items.summary: Historical PR 1799 verification commit changed source/search.html to correct the ValueSet percent-encoding example and remove escape-sensitive uri wording.
evidence_items.learned: The issue was applied in the authoritative current search-page source before this reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes record GF/FHIR-22679 as Persuasive with Mod and note that automatic URL unescaping makes escape-sensitive comparisons impractical or impossible.
evidence_items.learned: The meeting record corroborates the Jira resolution rationale and supports no further source change.

evidence_items.summary: A 2017 implementer thread quoted the old 'case, accent, and escape' sensitive URI-search sentence while discussing URI reference matching.
evidence_items.learned: This is background evidence of the old wording but does not conflict with the later Jira decision to remove escape sensitivity.
